description: Check whether one email address is deliverable. `emailStatus` is the verdict — `valid`, `invalid`, `catchall`, `malformed` or another value; when the domain belongs to a known company, a company summary is attached. The result has the full v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support.
name: validate_email
title: Validate Email
